rationale: The fourth student — the first trained on EXACT data. PRODIGY's post-mortem prescribed three fixes and BUTTSTEIN ships all three. (1) REPLAY SCHEMA V2: rows log the nearest-bullet-threat computed by the SAME closest-approach scan the runtime brains run (recorder and engine cannot disagree) plus the exact weapon label — the train/runtime reconstruction gap that sank the prodigy is closed. (2) SPRAY HEAT AS A SENSE (features v3, 48 floats): the prodigy fired ~36% of in-contact ticks and maxed the bloom because heat was invisible in v1 rows; BUTTSTEIN observes it and learned trigger discipline as a response to a state, not a mystery rhythm. (3) BLENDED AIM LABELS: every row trains the 24-bin head, rows whose shot landed within the 40-tick window carry 5x gradient (hit-exclusive was 6.6% — too sparse). Teacher: cuadrilla (gauntlet-best hand-written, +12.04). Fresh purpose-generated v2 corpus: 3,000,000 samples / 185 matches / 28 runs, stride 1, reserved gauntlet arenas+seeds excluded by assertion (106,919 hit-weighted = 3.56%). History dropout 0.5 carried from the exposure-bias fix. Best student validation ever: aim top-1 78.4% / top-3 92.2% / cos 0.887 on ALL rows (disciple: 56.8/82.8/0.760), 85.0/97.1 on hit rows; fire 93.9%, reload 98.0%. Factory FIRE_THRESH 0.2 (probed over 5 seeds — the only value that sustained on every seed); card tweak 0.15 — the full paired gauntlet preferred the hotter trigger by 1.5 kills/match (the disciple card pattern: factory sustains, card calibrates). THE VERDICT (full paired gauntlet, EVAL_SPEC_V1): score -30.46; BUTTSTEIN - DISCIPLE = -3.78 kills/match, 95% CI [-4.61, -2.98], sign +115/-258/=17. No succession yet — but the student lineage gap reads -9.83 -> -7.82 -> -3.78, halving again, with near-parity cells vs cuadrilla (-0.37), wolf (-1.80) and orca (-1.97). Gap to the teacher: -43.25/match (quick, CI [-45.61, -40.83]; prodigy was -47.03). Honest caveat: hit% 2.94 vs disciple 17.4 — BUTTSTEIN survives by dodging exact threats and trades volume for precision; the next student must close the hit-rate hole. A measurement of distillation, cleanly taken: exact data was worth +4 kills/match over the reconstruction.
